items.title: Cardinals Waive Third-Round RB Trey Benson with Injury Designation
items.one_line: Trey Benson's promising NFL run hit a heartbreaking snag when the Cardinals waived the young running back due to a nagging knee injury.

items.title: Rookie QB Jack Strand Shines as Falcons Crush Colts 34-6
items.one_line: Undrafted rookie Jack Strand stepped in and lit up the field, scrambling for a touchdown and throwing for 212 yards like he'd been there all along.

items.title: Lamar Jackson Named Ravens Starting QB for Week 1 vs. Colts
items.one_line: Lamar Jackson, back in uniform and throwing under sunny skies, is set to lead the Ravens against the Colts in Week 1.

items.title: Ravens Unveil 'White Noise' All-White Uniforms for Home Opener vs. Saints
items.one_line: Picture M&T Bank Stadium blanketed in white, with the Ravens in crisp all-white jerseys and pants topped by their Purple Rising helmets. Fans are gearing up to make it a deafening, blinding spectacle on September 20.

items.title: Ed Oliver Returns to Bills Practice After Son's Tragic Death
items.one_line: Ed Oliver stepped back onto the practice field Monday, stretching alongside teammates while carrying the weight of profound personal loss.

items.title: John Murphy Questions Joe Brady's Readiness for Bills Super Bowl Run
items.one_line: Longtime Bills broadcaster John Murphy penned a bold column, warning that young head coach Joe Brady lacks the experience to deliver a Super Bowl this year despite the team's strong preseason.

items.title: Bills Lead NFL with $610 Average Ticket Price in 2026
items.one_line: Bills fans are facing a big jump at the new Highmark Stadium, where average resale tickets hit $610—the highest in the NFL.

items.title: Panthers Plan Hubbard-Brooks Backfield Committee for Week 1
items.one_line: Chuba Hubbard's return from injury won't mean a solo workload. Coach Dave Canales laid out a shared backfield plan with Jonathon Brooks to start the season.

items.title: Bengals Release Veteran Lineman Cody Ford for Younger Talent
items.one_line: Cody Ford stepped up time and again for the Bengals, filling in at tackle or guard with little notice. Now, at 29, he's heading to free agency as the team turns to fresher faces.

items.title: C.J. Uzomah Retires as Bengal After 10-Year NFL Career
items.one_line: C.J. Uzomah signed a one-day contract to retire with the Bengals, the team that drafted him and became his second home for 21 percent of his life.

items.title: Browns Name Deshaun Watson Week 1 Starter Over Shedeur Sanders
items.one_line: After a tense preseason weekend of boos and an emotional response, Coach Todd Monken stuck with Deshaun Watson to lead the Browns on the road against Jacksonville.

items.title: Browns Stuck with Watson Due to Massive Contract Hit
items.one_line: Cleveland fans are fed up with Deshaun Watson as their starter, echoing a perfect post: 'The fans: Cut him. The media: Cut him. Deshaun: Cut me. The Browns: yea this is our guy.'

items.title: Cowboys Sign TE Mitchell Van Vooren Amid Injury Crunch
items.one_line: With tight ends dropping like flies to injuries, the Cowboys grabbed a 6-foot-5 track star to bolster their thin room just before the preseason finale.

items.title: Lions Sign Undrafted RB Roydell Williams Amid Injury Wave
items.one_line: With their running back room hit hard by injuries, the Detroit Lions turned to undrafted rookie Roydell Williams for fresh legs and depth.

items.title: Packers Rookie Cisse Cleared to Practice After Knee Scare
items.one_line: Fans held their breath as rookie cornerback Brandon Cisse hobbled off the field during Friday's preseason game. Coach Matt LaFleur eased worries with a simple update: 'He should be fine.'

items.title: Scuffle erupts between Green Bay Packers players Barryn Sorrell and Matthew Golden during training camp practice
items.one_line: Scuffle erupts between Green Bay Packers players Barryn Sorrell and Matthew Golden during training camp practice

items.title: Keisean Nixon's Leaping Interception Shines in Packers Camp
items.one_line: Keisean Nixon soared for a game-changing interception on Jordan Love's fourth-and-10 pass, right at the red zone's edge during Packers training camp.

items.title: Chiefs Rookie QB Garrett Nussmeier Impresses in Preseason Debuts
items.one_line: Garrett Nussmeier stepped into the pocket with calm confidence, dodging pressure and making smart reads that had fans buzzing right away.

items.title: Chiefs' Trey Smith Returns to Practice After Hip Injury
items.one_line: Trey Smith has been itching to hit the field again, and on Monday, he finally stepped back onto the practice grass at Arrowhead.

items.title: Chargers Place Center Tyler Biadasz on Season-Ending IR After Knee Injury
items.one_line: Tyler Biadasz, the Chargers' big offseason signing to protect Justin Herbert, suffered a devastating knee injury in practice. Now he's out for the season, forcing quick changes up front.

items.title: Chargers Offensive Line Shuffles with Pipkins at Left Guard
items.one_line: Fans are buzzing as veteran Trey Pipkins steps into first-team reps at left guard, protecting Justin Herbert during the final training camp push.

items.title: Rams Sign Gilmore and Deal, Activate Dedich in Roster Shuffle
items.one_line: The Rams bolstered their defense and line just in time for preseason, bringing in fresh talent while wishing well to a couple of injured players.

items.title: Raiders' Ashton Jeanty Scares Fans with Ankle Sprain in Practice
items.one_line: Ashton Jeanty dove for a low pass and crumpled, unable to bear weight on his right leg. The Raiders team knelt in prayer, capturing the raw worry in the moment.

items.title: Raiders Release Noah Brown Just Eight Days After Signing Him
items.one_line: Noah Brown joined the Raiders' training camp with high hopes, only to get released less than two weeks later. It's a quick turnaround that surprised many observers.

items.title: Raiders Donate $25 Million for Nevada's First Children's Hospital
items.one_line: Young patients held a handmade 'Thank You Raiders' sign at Allegiant Stadium as owner Mark Davis announced the team's biggest gift ever to local kids.

items.title: Dolphins Sign LB Jaheim Thomas and TE Ethan Conner Amid Injuries
items.one_line: With linebacker injuries piling up, the Dolphins found a gem in Jaheim Thomas during a key workout Monday.

items.title: Dolphins Rookie Chris Bell Practices Without Non-Contact Jersey
items.one_line: Chris Bell finally ditched the red non-contact jersey, hitting the field cleared for contact just nine months after his ACL tear.

items.title: J.J. McCarthy's Preseason Struggles Stir Vikings Backup QB Debate
items.one_line: J.J. McCarthy flashed a 50-yard strike against the Ravens, but red-zone misses left fans split on his backup role behind Kyler Murray.

items.title: Vikings Rookie Caleb Banks Admits He's Out of Shape After Preseason Loss
items.one_line: After the Vikings fell to the Ravens in preseason, first-round pick Caleb Banks stepped up to reporters with blunt honesty: he's out of shape and ready to hit the gassers hard.

items.title: Patriots Sign Veteran Punter Matt Haack After Baringer's Injury
items.one_line: Bryce Baringer's injury left the Patriots scrambling for a punter mid-game, with third-string QB Behren Morton stepping in to boot the kicks.

items.title: Patriots Trade Kayshon Boutte to Texans for Safety and Seventh-Round Pick
items.one_line: Patriots fans paused to remember Boutte's legendary playoff catch, even as they traded him away for a safety and future draft pick.

items.title: Saints Face Injury Wave as Training Camp Ends
items.one_line: With training camp wrapping up, the New Orleans Saints are nursing a long list of injuries, headlined by running back Ty Chandler's serious knee issue from Saturday's preseason game.

items.title: Saints Trade LB Deion Jones for RB Zamir White, Sign Kicker Daniel Carlson
items.one_line: With Alvin Kamara sidelined by a knee injury, the Saints moved fast to shore up their backfield and special teams.

items.title: Malik Nabers Practices Without Red Jersey in ACL Recovery Milestone
items.one_line: Malik Nabers flashed his old explosiveness with a diving grab and a turf-plucking catch, shedding the red non-contact jersey for the first time this summer.

items.title: Giants Waive Wide Receiver Ryan Miller Amid Roster Cuts
items.one_line: Ryan Miller, a 26-year-old receiver fighting for a spot, got the tough news as the Giants trim their roster. He couldn't crack a stacked depth chart despite preseason reps.

items.title: Giants Eye Trade for Mooney Amid Receiver Roster Crunch
items.one_line: Odell Beckham Jr. flashes the quickness that once made him a star, catching eyes as the Giants sort through a deep wide receiver group before final cuts.

items.title: Garrett Wilson's One-Handed Catches Steal Jets Camp Spotlight
items.one_line: Garrett Wilson snagged a one-handed catch that turned heads, setting up a touchdown in a sharp two-minute drill.

items.title: Jets Kickers York and Sanders Struggle in Key Practice
items.one_line: Both Jets placekickers missed routine mid-range field goals during Monday's practice, leaving coaches with a tough call ahead of roster cuts.

items.title: Eagles Fans Rally for Tanner McKee After ESPN Roster Snub
items.one_line: Eagles fans couldn't believe it when ESPN's latest roster projection cut Tanner McKee, keeping Jalen Hurts, Andy Dalton, and rookie Cole Payton instead. One supporter bluntly asked if the analysts were 'smoking crack' to drop him.

items.title: Steelers Activate Jalen Ramsey and Rookie Tackle from Injury Lists
items.one_line: Jalen Ramsey stepped onto the practice field in his white hoodie and full pads, his first real work since minicamp after a knee injury sidelined him.

items.title: Steelers Release Rookie Kicker Laith Marjan After Preseason Miss
items.one_line: Laith Marjan's 44-yard field goal sailed wide left in Friday's loss to the Jets, ending his brief stint with the Steelers just days later.

items.title: Steelers Activate Ramsey, Back Joey Porter Jr. Amid Contract Impasse
items.one_line: Jalen Ramsey stepped up after his activation, calling out the need to pay Joey Porter Jr. and get the full secondary on the field together.

items.title: Seahawks Waive Rookie Hankerson, Who Eyes College Return
items.one_line: Anthony Hankerson's NFL stint lasted just one week, but now the 22-year-old star from Oregon State plans to head back to college if he clears waivers.

items.title: Seahawks Fans Frustrated with Jason Myers' Preseason Field Goal Misses
items.one_line: Jason Myers' kicks kept drifting right in the preseason loss to the Titans, leaving Seahawks fans openly calling for a change at kicker.

items.title: 49ers Owner Jed York Arrested in Ohio Prostitution Sting, Pleads to Misdemeanors
items.one_line: Jed York, the San Francisco 49ers' principal owner, walked into a routine human trafficking sting and faced a quick courtroom reckoning just weeks before NFL kickoff.

items.title: Mike Evans Leaves 49ers Practice Early with Quad Tightness
items.one_line: Mike Evans sprinted downfield on a deep route, then headed off early from practice, leaving fans hoping it's just a minor hiccup before the season.

items.title: 49ers Sign Bay Area Native Viliami Fehoko Jr. to One-Year Deal
items.one_line: Viliami Fehoko Jr., a towering Bay Area product from San Jose State, is heading home to bolster the 49ers' defensive line.

items.title: ESPN Analyst Predicts Bucs NFC Title Game Run
items.one_line: Kimberley A. Martin leaned into the camera on First Take, declaring the Buccaneers 'right there' for an NFC title game berth this season.

items.title: Titans Debut Stunning Light Blue Uniforms in Preseason Win
items.one_line: The Titans hit the field in their fresh light blue uniforms Sunday night, and fans couldn't get enough of the crisp, modern look that honors Nashville's music roots.

items.title: Dan Quinn Confident in Commanders' Center Options Despite Injuries
items.one_line: With veteran Nick Allegretti still recovering from a calf injury, rookie Matt Gulbin steps up for more reps at center this week.

items.title: Commanders Rookie Sonny Styles Shines in Zone Coverage Breakdown
items.one_line: In a clever fake blitz, seventh-overall pick Sonny Styles dropped back smoothly, blanketing receivers and forcing a scramble. Endzone angles caught every fluid redirect.

items.title: Lions Edge Commanders 17-13 in Preseason with Dobbs' 50-Yard TD Run
items.one_line: Joshua Dobbs bolted 50 yards for a touchdown, sealing the Lions' narrow preseason win over the Commanders as fans vented frustration online.
